acquisition method: The MS was operated in data-dependent mode with an MS1 resolution of 35,000
alkylation reagent: resuspended in 500 µL GdmCL lysis buffer (6 M GdmCl, 100 mM Tris pH8.5, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM Iodoacetamide)
alkylation concentration: resuspended in 500 µL GdmCL lysis buffer (6 M GdmCl, 100 mM Tris pH8.5, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM Iodoacetamide)
cleavage agent: resuspended in 100 µl of fresh 100 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate with 8% Acetonitrile (ACN) and 5 µg trypsin
collision energy: an isolation window of 1.4 m/z and a normalized collision energy of 25
enrichment method: identified EYA4 interacting proteins using a BioID2 proximity proteomics strategy
instrument: Mass spectrometry was performed using a Thermo Q Exactive instrument
labeling: Biotinylation of proteins after expression of Myc-BioID2-EYA4 was compared to a BioID2-Myc control using mass spectrometry with label-free quantification (LFQ)
reduction reagent: resuspended in 500 µL GdmCL lysis buffer (6 M GdmCl, 100 mM Tris pH8.5, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM Iodoacetamide)
reduction concentration: resuspended in 500 µL GdmCL lysis buffer (6 M GdmCl, 100 mM Tris pH8.5, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM Iodoacetamide)
